intro: Recent work across Northeastern Pennsylvania. These are our own photographs from our own jobs — nothing here is stock.

projects.title: Commercial flat roof — before
projects.alt: Aerial view of an aging commercial flat roof with visible weathering and ponding before replacement
projects.description: A distribution building whose low-slope membrane had reached the end of its life — chalked, patched and holding water.

projects.title: Commercial flat roof — after
projects.alt: The same commercial building photographed from the air after a new low-slope roof system was installed
projects.description: The same building with a new low-slope system installed and the drainage corrected, phased so the business kept trading throughout.

projects.title: Low-slope membrane — before
projects.alt: Close aerial view of a worn low-slope roof membrane with seam repairs before tear-off
projects.description: Seams opening up across the field, with previous patch repairs no longer holding.

projects.title: Low-slope membrane — after
projects.alt: Newly installed dark low-slope roof membrane on a commercial building
projects.description: New membrane down, clean and uniform across the whole field.

projects.title: Full commercial replacement — before
projects.alt: Wide aerial view of a large commercial roof showing extensive weathering before work began
projects.description: The full extent of the job before we started — a large single-span roof with no serviceable life left in it.

projects.title: Full commercial replacement — after
projects.alt: Wide aerial view of the completed commercial roof replacement and the surrounding parking area
projects.description: Completed, with the parking area and grounds left as we found them.

projects.title: Architectural shingle roof
projects.alt: Dark architectural shingle roof with two dormer windows on a residential home
projects.description: Owens Corning Duration Series shingles, with the dormer and valley detailing that decides whether a roof like this leaks.

projects.title: Residential shingle replacement
projects.alt: A residential home with a newly installed architectural shingle roof
projects.description: A single-day residential tear-off and replacement.

projects.title: Standing seam metal roof
projects.alt: Blue standing seam metal roof with a dormer on a residential home
projects.description: Standing seam panels — the option homeowners pick when they would rather not think about the roof again.

projects.title: Seamless gutter installation
projects.alt: A roofer installing a section of seamless gutter against a blue sky
projects.description: Seamless gutter, sized and pitched to carry the water away from the wall. Five-year workmanship warranty.
